scenes: Can heat weigh on the mind?
Yes. On hotter days, studies find more anxiety and distress, | more visits for mental health care, | and harder days for people living with mental illness.
So heat plans can include the mind: | people in mental health care, and those who support them, need cool places too.
A cooler mind needs a cooler place.
